biggest_catch: The referred checking account must stay open 90 days with a balance over $0 on day 90, so the bonus pays roughly 120 days after the account opens.
catches: Existing CSB consumer client earns a $100 Refer-A-Friend bonus per referred new client who opens a consumer checking account.
Existing clients can earn unlimited Refer-A-Friend bonuses.
Referred account must be open a minimum of 90 calendar days, with no previously closed CSB consumer checking account within the past 12 months.
Referred account must have a balance greater than zero at end of business on the 90th calendar day.
Bonus applied as a credit within 30 calendar days after the 90-day qualifying period; both accounts must be open at payout.
Must be an Iowa resident to open an account; minimum opening deposit $100 ($25 for BankOn Checking).
All bonuses reported to the IRS; client responsible for taxes; cannot be combined with other offers.
